items.title: Nifty falls for sixth straight session; oil surge, CAS volatility rattle markets
items.description: Indian markets faced pressure as the Nifty declined for a sixth consecutive trading session. Rising oil prices and ongoing West Asia conflict kept traders cautious throughout the day. The Nifty closed lower, reflecting broader market weakness and investor concerns. Domestic institutional investors provided some buying support, while FPIs also bought shares. Technical indicators suggest a period of consolidation for the indices in the near term.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: The Nifty index continued its decline for a sixth consecutive session this week. Elevated crude oil prices and global tensions are impacting market sentiment negatively. Analysts anticipate continued pressure on Indian equities in the immediate future. Foreign and domestic institutional investors showed net buying activity on Tuesday. The Indian rupee closed slightly weaker due to oil prices and bond yields.

items.title: Stocks in news: ONGC, BPCL, RailTel Corporation, Exide Industries and Lohia Corp
items.description: The Indian stock market experienced a downward trend for the sixth consecutive session on Tuesday, influenced by rising oil prices and soaring global bond yields. Key companies like ONGC and BPCL will attract attention due to recent corporate developments. More newsworthy, RailTel Corporation and Compucom Software have landed significant contracts with government bodies. Additionally, Lohia Corp and others are expected to report their first-quarter earnings today.

items.title: India's outward FDI jumps 17% to $5.7 billion in July: RBI
items.description: India’s outward FDI rose 17% year-on-year to $5.70 billion in July from $4.88 billion a year earlier, according to provisional RBI data. It was also higher than the $3.14 billion recorded in June.

items.title: L&T Finance plans 500 new gold loan branches this fiscal
items.description: L&T Finance plans to open 500 new gold loan branches this financial year. This expansion aims to increase its network significantly and capitalize on sector growth. The company entered the gold loan market last year after acquiring Paul Merchants Finance. Gold loans are a key driver for L&T Finance's growth agenda.

items.title: Dividend alert! Mazagon Dock, Natco Pharma among 15 stocks turning ex-dividend on Thursday. Do you own any?
items.description: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders in April had announced that its board of directors have recommended a final dividend of Rs 4.62 per share for the financial year 2026. The company later fixed August 20 as the record date to determine the eligibility of shareholders set to receive the payment.

items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 13 stocks' close prices crossed below their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on August 18, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Trading below the 200 DMA is considered a negative signal because it indicates that the stock's price is below its long-term trend line. items.title: CCI approves Prudential’s stake acquisition in Bharti Life Insurance
items.description: The Competition Commission of India has approved Prudential Corporation of India’s acquisition of certain equity shareholding in Bharti Life Insurance Company. The transaction is still subject to other applicable regulatory and statutory approvals.

items.title: Milky Mist Dairy Foods lists at 18% premium to issue price
items.description: Mumbai-based Milky Mist Dairy Foods made a strong debut on the NSE, listing at ₹165—17.9% above its issue price of ₹140. The stock climbed further to close at the day’s high of ₹181.50, valuing the company at ₹13,972.66 crore at the close.

items.title: Tube Investments among 5 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On August 18, five Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% were identified using the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. “RSI trending up” indicates that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) is rising, suggesting strengthening price momentum in the stock. This may signal potential upward movement and can be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Behari Lal Engineering shares set to debut today; GMP signals 47% premium ahead of listing
items.description: The IPO, which was open for subscription from August 12 to August 14, drew an overwhelming response from investors and was subscribed 108.44 times overall. The retail portion was subscribed 53.27 times, while the QIB and NII categories saw exceptionally strong demand, with subscriptions of 165.33 times and 165.32 times, respectively.

items.title: Shiprocket shares to list today; GMP signals 37% listing gains
items.description: The Rs 1,617.48-crore IPO, which was open for subscription from August 12 to August 14, received an overwhelming response from investors. The issue was subscribed 99.38 times overall, reflecting exceptionally strong demand across investor categories.

items.title: Stocks to buy: 5 midcap and chemical stocks with up to 25% upside potential
items.description: Axis Securities in its latest report listed out five midcap and chemical stocks on which it recommends ‘Buy’ rating, as it believes they offer an attractive combination of earnings visibility, structural growth and improving operating performance, based on earnings assessment and medium-term outlook. “We believe companies with strong balance sheets, differentiated capabilities and execution track records are likely to gain market share as industry conditions improve,” it said. Here are the five stocks with their respective target prices and upside potentials.

items.title: Bosch among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of August 18, there was a notable surge in futures open interest for four stocks in the NSE F&O pack, contributing to a total increase in open interest of over 10% as compared to the previous trade. A significant uptick in futures open interest signifies a substantial growth in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a specific security. This uptrend reflects an increasing number of participants either initiating new positions or expanding the size of their existing positions within the futures market.

items.title: Strong Q1 results spark stock-picking rush: 50 top ideas for investors to buy
items.description: The impressive earnings reported in the first quarter have led brokerages to unveil fresh stock-picking avenues. Investors are encouraged to seek out firms showcasing strong earnings and solid financial fundamentals. A collective effort from various brokerages has resulted in the identification of fifty prime stock options, covering diverse industries such as banking, automotive, and defense. The market is now pivoting towards an earnings-led cycle with an emphasis on quality companies.

items.title: Action Construction Equipment among 4 stocks flashing bullish signals, indicating possible uptrend
items.description: On August 18, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 5% appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns for informed decisions about future price movements in financial markets.

items.title: India Inc’s blockbuster Q1 earnings may not last as 3 key tailwinds fade in H2
items.description: India Inc's impressive earnings in the first quarter might not sustain their momentum into the latter half of the year. Diminishing effects from favorable base conditions and a slowdown in consumption stimulation are anticipated. Additionally, while a declining rupee and rising commodity costs have provided brief respite, analysts caution that profit growth could significantly slow down in the coming months, marking a stark contrast to the earlier strong performance.

items.title: D-Street’s CAS turmoil clouds BSE’s growth outlook
items.description: BSE shares have experienced a significant downturn this month following the launch of a new closing auction session. Since this change on August third, trading volumes and options activity have considerably dropped, raising concerns among analysts who have downgraded their outlook on the stock. The exchange is grappling with new funding rules and possible fee changes, but some analysts remain optimistic about a turnover rebound by October.

items.title: Sensex falls 100 points, Nifty below 23,150 as market bleeds for 7th session. What lies ahead?
items.description: On Wednesday morning, Indian stock markets faced further setbacks as both the Sensex and Nifty indices continued their downward trend, marking an ongoing losing streak. The broader market indices echoed this sentiment, showing substantial selling pressure. Notably, shares of Bajaj Finserv and Bajaj Finance led the decline on the Sensex, while IT stocks such as HCL Tech and Infosys managed to defy the overall trend by recording gains.

items.title: RailTel Corporation shares rally 5% after bagging Rs 166.8 crore EPFO order
items.description: RailTel shares gained nearly 5% after the company received a Rs 166.80 crore work order from EPFO for a one-year extension of its Infrastructure-as-a-Service engagement. While the order strengthens revenue and order-book visibility, technical indicators remain weak, with the stock trading below all 8 monitored SMAs and its RSI at 32.5. FII holding also rose modestly in the June 2026 quarter.
